repairs.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
repairs.current_note: The wear is conceded and then not held against the thing - overuse has smoothed it rather than used it up, which is what *threadbare* and *shopworn* make of the same wearing.
repairs.reader_said: The gloss says 'repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse', so the overuse is already the fault. The note said the wear is 'not held against the thing' and has 'smoothed it' - that is the worn-in, comfortable sense of well-worn (a path, a pair of shoes), not overfamiliarity through overuse.
repairs.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

whole_family.gloss: not original; not being or productive of something fresh and unusual
whole_family.tone: The flat statement of the fault - nothing fresh in the thing and nothing fresh coming out of it - delivered without the scorn *trite* carries.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: Dismissal rather than description: the repetition has emptied the thing out, where *commonplace* only notes that it has been met before.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: Puts the fault in ordinariness rather than in damage - the thing is met everywhere rather than worn thin, which is what *threadbare* and *shopworn* make of the same overuse.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: A formal-sounding verdict that the thing has been run into the ground, heavier and more deliberate than *tired*.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: Informal and offhand: it shrugs at how familiar the thing has become instead of condemning it the way *banal* does.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: The overuse leaves a mark, as though the thing had been handled until the shine came off it - grubbier than *well-worn*.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: The flattest word here - it files the endless repetition almost as a category rather than a fault, with none of the disgust in *trite*.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: The wear has gone all the way through: the thing still holds its shape but has nothing left in it, harsher than *well-worn*.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: Lays the wearing at time's door rather than at any user's: the overuse registers as accumulated age, not as the running-into-the-ground that *hackneyed* convicts someone of.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: Blunt and plain: the thing has simply gone slack from repetition, a flatter judgement than the arch *bromidic*.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: The hardest word in the family - it does not merely note the overuse, it writes the thing off as worthless for it.

whole_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
whole_family.tone: The wear is conceded and then not held against the thing - overuse has smoothed it rather than used it up, which is what *threadbare* and *shopworn* make of the same wearing.

whole_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
whole_family.tone: Keeps a straight face while it convicts - dull, wearying and puffed up with significance, all named at once, where *corny* simply laughs.

whole_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
whole_family.tone: Informal and mocking: both the dullness and the airs come off as laughable, lighter on its feet than *platitudinous*.

whole_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
whole_family.tone: The drier of the pair - it names the tiresome self-importance almost clinically, without the heavy roll of *platitudinous*.

whole_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
whole_family.tone: A weightier, more sonorous word than *platitudinal*, and its own bulk is part of the mockery: dullness dressed up and then shown up.

repairs.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
repairs.current_note: The formal member of the group, registering the trouble as a mind put out of its settled state, where *disturbing* unseats it and *distressing* names outright hurt.
repairs.fault: other - positional claim collides with the family
repairs.reader_said: 'The formal member of the group' claims the formal slot alone, but *distressful* in the same family is noted as the stiffer, more formal shape of *distressing*. The contrast offered against *disturbing* ('put out of its settled state' versus 'unseats it') draws no real difference either.
repairs.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

whole_family.gloss: marked by great psychological weight; weighted down especially with sadness or troubles or
whole_family.tone: The plainest name for the condition itself, sadness or trouble felt as weight from inside, where *burdensome* describes the load from outside.

whole_family.gloss: not easily borne; wearing
whole_family.tone: Puts the difficulty in the thing rather than the bearer: a load fixed on you that has to be carried, not merely a strain that tires.

whole_family.gloss: not easily borne; wearing
whole_family.tone: The formal member, and the heaviest-sounding of the three, where *taxing* keeps the same complaint everyday.

whole_family.gloss: not easily borne; wearing
whole_family.tone: Leans on the wearing half of the sense, draining strength steadily rather than crushing, the lightest of the three.

whole_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
whole_family.tone: The plain, full-strength member of the group, naming real hurt and not merely unease.

whole_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
whole_family.tone: The stiffer, more formal shape of *distressing*, with the same weight of hurt behind it.

whole_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
whole_family.tone: Aimed at composure rather than comfort, it unsettles and goes on unsettling, where *distressing* simply hurts.

whole_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
whole_family.tone: The formal member of the group, registering the trouble as a mind put out of its settled state, where *disturbing* unseats it and *distressing* names outright hurt.

whole_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
whole_family.tone: Quiet and persistent, a worry that nags at you instead of striking, understated beside *distressing*.

whole_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
whole_family.tone: Treats the power to cause anxiety as a standing property of the thing, where *worrying* reports what it is doing now.

whole_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
whole_family.tone: Keeps to the worry-and-anxiety end of the sense, unease rather than the hurt *distressing* names.

whole_family.gloss: made heavy or weighted down with weariness
whole_family.tone: The most physical word in the family, heaviness and weariness fused into dead metal, dull and unliftable.

whole_family.gloss: made heavy or weighted down with weariness
whole_family.tone: The flattest member, recording that the weight has been put on without making the weariness of it felt as *leaden* does.

whole_family.gloss: weighing heavily on the senses or spirit
whole_family.tone: The strongest weight here, pressing on the senses as much as on the spirit and leaving no room to breathe.

whole_family.gloss: weighing heavily on the spirit; causing anxiety or worry
whole_family.tone: Grave rather than smothering, the weight registering as anxiety carried, where *oppressive* closes in.
